args.title: Support currency sign prefixes in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Change parseAmount function to recognize and remove the rupee sign (₹) and other possible currency signs from the raw amount string before parsing. This will allow amounts with the currency sign in front, like `₹1,250.00` and `-₹310.50`, to be correctly parsed rather than rejected as 'not a number'.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue occurs because parseAmount does not handle currency signs like the rupee sign (₹) at the start of the amount string. This causes amounts with a leading currency sign to be rejected as 'not a number'. The responsible file is src/util/money.ts where parseAmount can be updated to strip such currency symbols before parsing.
